notes: `עַד` + `פֹּה` → *Hitherto* was re-tested under rule 30: one English word carries both the limit and the deixis, and the unit heads on `פֹּה`, which carries the lexeme (rule 23).
`בִּגְאוֹן גַּלֶּיךָ` is recast attributively as *thy proud waves* (rule 28), leaving the `בְּ` no English word of its own (rule 40).
